Name: Apple's Art Room Furniture - AT
Author: appleschloss
Description:
This all started cause I wanted to make an art studio for my current save, but I couldn't find a mod that had the furniture I wanted. And now here we are with my first ever attempt at a Stardew mod. I've played modded for years but never made a mod myself, so if there's anything funky let me know! I did my best to test it in game first.

At the moment there's 10 pieces of furniture (not including their swatches). I tried to make sure every furniture piece I replaced was one easily accessible in the Furniture Catalogue. We've got-

Added in 1.0.1
[list]
[*]Hanging Aprons - replaces Clouds Banner, has 3 colors and 3 variants for each color
[*]Corkboard - replaces 'Pathways' painting (every artist needs a place to hang their art!)

[/list]
Plus the original furniture:
[list]
[*]Canvases - replaces Artist Bookcase, Luxury Bookcase, Modern Bookcase, Dark Bookcase. (looks best up against a wall as if leaning there)
[*]Art Hanging to Dry - replaces 'The Muzzamaroo' (can be placed side by side to make a longer string of them)
[*]Yarn Ball with Needles - replaces the Futan Bear
[*]Polaroid - replaces the Futan Bear
[*]Basket of Yarn Balls - replaces Model Ship or S. Pine
[*]Splattered Throw Tarp - replaces Patchwork Rug
[*]Stained End Tables - one for Oak, Birch, and Walnut
[*]Easel (with or without canvas) - replaces any of the House Plants
[/list]
I may or may not add more in the future if I think of ideas (feel free to suggest some!) If you have any desire to play around with my mod in any way, honestly just hmu. You can find me primarily on tumblr (username appleschloss)

Have fun!
